> **中文一句话**：DET 是 DSH 的永久插件 —— 让 AI 开你自己已登录的浏览器、任意消息开分支改问、跑/快照/回退真工程、管所有插件与每一笔 token；2.10 起再加两件事：**A
LV** 给图片造坐标系（栅格·辅助线·边线坐标·本机 OCR），**ADU** 让工具按需装载（启动只装 5 个元工具）。
## 😤 The problem
If you hack on real code with an AI agent in the loop, you already know these five:
| Pain | What everyone does today | What DET does |
| 🧠 **One wrong turn kills the thread** — you want to re-ask from message #12, not start over | Copy
-paste into a fresh chat and lose all context | **VTD**: edit / retry **any** message → a real hidde

n branch, switch back with `<N>`, and the **workspace code rolls back with you** |
| 🌐 **The AI can'
t see or click what you see** — your logged-in dashboards, internal pages, `file://` pages | Screens
hot, paste, hand-hold, retry | **DET Browser Extension**: the model drives **your already-logged-in

Edge/Chrome** through a localhost bridge you gate yourself (off / read / write / on) |
| 👁 **"I thin
k the number is 41.00 but the crop is blurry"** — vision models guess coordinates | Re-ask, re-scree
nshot, hope | **ALV**: grids, rulers, guide lines, edge positions and on-device OCR with per-word bo

xes — *then* let the model look |
| 🛠 **Build-run-look-check is a manual loop** | Alt-Tab to the IDE
and terminal 40 times an hour | Right toolbar: **▶ run · 🗎 file tree + preview/edit · 🕘 program sna

pshots & rollback** |
[该节后续省略]
## 🆕 What changed in 2.10 / 2.11
Three answers to three long-standing problems:
| Problem | Answer |
| A vision model looks at *a picture*, not *a coordinate system* | **ALV** — 8 tools that build the
scaffolding: grid, ruler, guide lines, edge positions, on-device OCR, tiling, annotation, enhancemen

t |
| Every turn paid for 30+ tool schemas while using one or two | **ADU** — boot with 5 meta tools

, mount modules on demand (`adu_list` → `adu_describe` → `adu_load`) |
| Failures only produced one
word: `browser-timeout` | **Per-command budgets + structured failures + a failure ledger** (`_diagPu
sh` → `detHealth` panel) |
A real ALV round trip, on a table screenshot:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### Why `adu_rememory` exists
Long conversations get compacted. Tool *schemas* survive, but the model's working memory of "which t
ool does what, with which parameters" gets summarized away — and re‑mounting does not help, because
nothing was unmounted. `adu_rememory` returns a compact index (one line per tool: `name(params) — wh
at it does`) built from the same table that drives the module list, so the model can pick up exactly
where it left off without paying schema budget twice.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Four rules keep it honest:
1. **The module table is the single source of truth** (`lib/adu.js`); the meta tools only validate a

nd report — they hold no state.
2. **Mounting reuses the very same disposer pipeline** as the master
switch and the UI switches, so there is never a "second state". Bookkeeping lives in `_aduGroups` (

`id → [disposer]`).
3. **Sticky by design**: mounts persist to `det.adu.mounted` and are restored at

boot. Only `adu_unload`, the master switch, or unloading the plugin removes them.
4. **Turning ADU
off is the escape hatch**: flip `ADU 按需装载` off (or set `aduBoot: "eager"`) and you are back to load-
everything at boot — applied immediately, no restart.
## 🗺 Feature map
`Settings → DET 管理器` groups the switches by concern. Two new groups in 2.10 (identifier in parenthes
tings → DET 管理器` groups the switches by concern. Two new groups in 2.10 (identifier in parentheses):
| Group | Switches |

| **界面注入** | 文件视图 (`file`) · 运行按钮 (`run`) · 版本控制 (`ver`) |
| **对话与版本** | VTD (`vtd`) — branch / edit

/ retry + message micro-versions |
| **分组与插件** | MDA 分组 (`mda`) · 插件管理 (`plugins`) |
| **成本优化** | M

MS 混合模型 (`mms`) |
| **DLT 集成** | 文档工具 · 右栏预览 · 环境表 · 执行与编译 · 每轮成本 · 草图导入 (`dltDocs` … `dltDraft`) |

| **识图与工具预算** 🆕 | ALV 辅助线视觉 (`alv`) · ADU 按需装载 (`adu`) |
| **安全与审批** | 代码修改审批 · AI 命令审计 · Prompt 攻击防
御 (`approve` / `secCmdAudit` / `secPromptDefense`) |
Plus the **master switch** (`master`): off = stock DSH, with only this settings page (and the switch
) left behind. Every switch takes effect immediately, persists in `~/.dsh/storages`, and unloads its
UI along with its tools.
## 🏗 Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Design rules that this repo actually enforces with tests:
- **One table, one owner.** Feature keys live in `normalizeFeatures`; their labels/grouping live in

`DET_FEATURE_GROUPS`; the client-structure suite fails if they drift apart (`每个功能键恰好归组一次`).
- **Neve
r break the whole for one part.** Every registration goes through `safe(...)` + disposers; a single

failing sub-capability cannot take the plugin down.
- **Facts vs. intent.** `globallyEnabled` is an
*intent* record; the loader is the *fact*. They are reported side by side and never overwrite each o

ther.
- **Loadable modules are not a second state.** ADU mounts through the same disposers the maste

r switch uses.
- **Diagnostics never throw.** `_diagPush` and every probe is try/catch-wrapped; a di
agnostic bug must not become an outage.
